name: DICTO TPP (Triangle-Pentagon Polyhedron)
scale_note: UP frame of #38/#39: icosidodecahedron of circumradius phi with corners (+-phi,0,0) cyclic and (+-1/2, +-phi/2, +-phi^2/2) cyclic (twice the edge midpoints of the icosahedron (0, +-1/2, +-phi/2) cyclic, edge 1); T(S) = {x : v.x <= v.v for every corner v of S}. The OG here is the #31 OG at the UP size (corners: the 30 ID corners, the 60 points 2c - v in each ID triangle (c its centre), and 12 apexes on the five-fold axes in the kite planes). This solid is T^3(OG).
